dataset.name: TechManualQA-700
dataset.split_rule: No official dev/test split is published. Within each category, sort question_id by its numeric suffix and assign even indexes to dev and odd indexes to test. This assignment uses only ids and categories.
dataset.passage_rule: Zenodo publishes question, answer snippet, and page number. It does not publish page text. Each distinct (manual, snippet) pair is one passage. Unanswerable rows have page number None and are not passages.

bm25: SQLite FTS5. Documents keep every token. Queries use the production 80-token cap.
note: Test split refuses knob overrides. Unanswerable questions are excluded from Recall, MRR, and nDCG. sqlite-vec is not used because its KNN k limit is 4096.
